{{Quote|How ya doin'? So you wanna talk with Borvo? Well, that ain't easy. You wanna help us out, then maybe I'll vouch for ya?|Borvo's guard, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BG" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''guard''' was employed by [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|One of our most trusted guys! He even trained me. Wait, you're not a cop are you? You take out Frangee and that'll prove you're not a rat snitch yourself.|Borvo's guard, to a spacer about Niksel Frangee|<ref name="SWG:BG" />}}
When the guard first began working for [[Borvo]] the Hutt on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], he was trained by [[Niksel Frangee]] one of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] most trusted employees. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the man had become Borvo's personal guard. He was based in the [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] [[Moenia Cantina|Cantina]] which acted as the Hutt's base of operations for his business ventures on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Naboo.<ref name="SWG:BG" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Dagorel]], one of Borvo's thugs, was shot in an ambush during a mission in the [[Paitnnu Wetlands]] and severely injured. The guard quickly hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find him, give him a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]] and escort him back to the Moenia. Borvo's guard later found out that Dagorell was set up by Niksel Frangee, a undercover officer in the [[Corellian Security Force]] and hired the spacer again to murder Frangee.<ref name="SWG:BG" /> The spacer took Frangee's detective badge and Borvo's guard ordered the spacer to go on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to pass himself off as Frangee. During his six years in infiltration, all of Frangee's direct superiors had retired and been replaced. Thus, nobody in the CorSec knew how Frangee looked like at the moment of his death.<ref name="SWG:BGATTC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Borvo's Guard - A Trip To Corellia|Naboo}}</ref> The spacer met one of the CorSec senior officers, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Thale Dustrunner]], in the [[Coronet Capitol]]. Dustrunner fell for the ruse and took the spacer for the long lost agent. He ordered him to protect [[Aldalad]], a witness who wanted to testify against Borvo, and [[Maerzen]], who had discovered evidence against Borvo the Hutt. The spacer killed both of them and returned to Borvo's guard, leaving the CorSec without any evidence against the Hutt crime lord.<ref name="SWG:BC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Bluffing CorSec|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BorvoNPCTemplate.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Borvo's guard]]
Borvo's guard appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Because Borvo's guard spawned under the generic "borvos_guard" template, his appearance was randomized under one of five possible depictions. However, he always appeared as male.<ref name="SWG:BG" />

Borvo's guard was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Borvo the Hutt questline (pre-NGE)|Borvo the Hutt's questline]].<ref name="SWG:BtHG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Borvo The Hutt's Guard|Naboo}}</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> Borvo the Hutt's questline was [[W:c:swg:Borvo the Hutt questline|revamped]]. While the gameplay of the questline was extensively upgraded, the storyline remained similar.<ref name="SWG:BG" />
